$comment: The site config of wirelab (CI.md of the template, "The site config"). pages.yml deploys this site from main, and the job site of ci.yml checks it on each pull request. The home page is the Vite build of packages/site. site-pages adds the Releases page and the Status page. The check opens each page in a browser at each width, in light and dark, and the probe drives the catalog: the list, the details of a row and the filters.
